summary: Retest of 3 critical fixes from iteration_9 (cart drawer close on /checkout, buy-now bypass drawer, mobile horizontal overflow + hero-popular stacking) plus desktop regression sweep. ALL 3 critical fixes verified. No regressions found. 100% pass rate on all tested flows.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js Layout uses useEffect on location.pathname to auto-close drawer/search — good defensive pattern.
add(p,v,buy) branches: if buy => setDrawer(false)+nav('/checkout'); else => setDrawer(true). Clean.
Minor: hero-copy testid was requested by review-request but element only has className='hero-copy'. Tests worked via CSS selector. Consider adding data-testid='hero-copy' for testability.
Minor: no data-testid on section.hero (uses class only). Could add data-testid='hero-section' for consistency.
App.js is a single very large file — code review guideline: files >700 lines should be split into focused modules. Consider extracting Layout, ProductCard, CartDrawer, Checkout into separate files.
seed_data_creation: None (cart/checkout/reviews use localStorage only per spec)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 critical iteration_9 fixes verified working: (1) cart drawer closes on /checkout via setDrawer(false)+nav in onCheckout, (2) buy-now closes drawer before navigation, (3) mobile hero-popular stacks with position:relative below hero-copy and body scrollWidth=390 with no horizontal overflow. Desktop regressions all passing. App is ready for deploy from a functional standpoint. Only minor code-quality suggestion: App.js is oversized; consider modularization before scaling.
